title: Canonical projection coefficient-change equation
statement: Let $R,S$ be the recorded coefficient systems, $a:R\to S$ a coefficient change, $c=(j,p)$ a compactification of $f:X\to Y$, and $K,L$ derived $R$-modules on $X,Y$. Define $\operatorname{CompactSupportProjectionChange}(a,c,K,L)$ to require the two coefficient pullback-composition identities for $j,p$, and, for every proof of those identities and every tensor model at $X,Z,Y$ for both coefficient systems, the projection-change square: extend the actual $R$ projection then apply support coefficient comparison and tensor comparison, or first tensor the support comparison and coefficient pullback comparison then apply the actual $S$ projection. The two composites must coincide. Tensor and support maps are the published normalized maps; the condition does not choose arbitrary comparison isomorphisms. The constituent notions are [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] [def-exchange-projection] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] [def-sf-projection-coefficient-tensor-total].
